rationale: The candidate materially fixes both prior blockers: stopEpoch is losslessly bounded to the frozen JSON/JS safe-integer domain with enforced exhaustion behavior, and every privileged RPC uses kernel-authenticated UID authorization against a root-owned, fail-closed role allowlist rather than peer groups. It also establishes mechanically enforceable ADMIN/CLIENT separation and leaves grant consumption entirely dormant, with no V1C execution-effect route.
